name: ask-sales-v5-8-final-promotion-gate-preregistration-2026-07-27

eligible: A realistic sales-rep question with a complete, readable threaded answer from Rich, Mike, Rudy, Raul, or Madeline
The answer can be converted into an auditable label without guessing at missing screenshot or private context
The question tests stable knowledge, a natural follow-up, an exact relationship or qualifier, or an intentional passive-chatbot routing boundary
Every final source message ID has zero overlap with earlier Ask Sales evaluation datasets and runtime artifacts
excluded: Screenshot-only, attachment-only, peer-only, self-replied, joke, announcement, malformed, or unresolved threads
Questions that would not realistically be asked of the passive Ask Sales chatbot
Pure live actions except a small preregistered routing-control stratum
Questions whose answer requires unavailable private context or a current live-status lookup
Any source or wording used to design, tune, or development-test V5.8
selectionProtocol.authorityReview: Review exact decision scope and recency, not speaker rank alone. Rich normally controls Sales policy over Madeline when both govern the same decision; a newer Madeline statement can control a changed or narrower decision when the evidence supports that reading.
selectionProtocol.selectionOrder: Select and seal the complete source-audited gold set before executing V3 or V5.8. Runtime output must not affect inclusion, wording, labels, or source interpretation.
